name: Is it possible to sell my home for cash if it needs significant repairs?

mainEntity.name: Is it possible to sell my home for cash if it needs significant repairs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, many cash home buyers specialize in purchasing properties that require significant repairs or renovations. These buyers often factor the cost of repairs into their offer price. It's a practical tradeoff: you avoid renovation costs and time, but the offer may reflect the buyer's planned investment in the property.
acceptedAnswer.description: Many cash buyers purchase homes needing repairs, factoring renovation costs into their offer.
